data.name: Mumtiha
data.gender_notes: Mumtiha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'mamtu', meaning 'to relieve' or 'to help'. In Islamic history, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) used this term to describe those who aid in spreading knowledge and righteousness. The name Mumtiha carries the meaning “Reliever, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mumtiha usually hope their child will grow to embody reliever, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May the name of Mumtiha inspire you to be a helper and spread kindness and knowledge to those in need.
data.etymology: Mumtiha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Reliever, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mumtiha total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_urdu.name: ممتحہ
in_urdu.meaning: ایک خوبصورت اور محبوب نام، معنی ممتع و پیارا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ممتحہ ایک عربی मूल کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ممتع، پیارا اور خوبصورت۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں ان شخصیات کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو اپنی خوبصورتی اور محبوبیت کی وجہ سے مشہور ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मुम्तिहा
in_hindi.meaning: एक सुंदर और प्रिय नाम, अर्थ मम्त और प्यारा
